conditional_example.premises: Let M = StrategicMinute::MAX = u64::MAX. Assume an existing positive-amount foreign blood deposit at M−1 whose disease snapshot is a supported blood-compatible disease. Take from=M−1 and to=M. Source defines duration as two days = 2,880 minutes.
conditional_example.age_and_fraction: calendar.rs:99–116, 144–150 defines M and saturating arithmetic; filth.rs:81–87 computes elapsed age M−(M−1)=1 and the positive fraction 1−1/2,880.
conditional_example.window: filth.rs:90–118 documents the excluded from cursor and computes first_uncommitted=M. Its end is (M−1).saturating_add_minutes(2,880).saturating_sub_minutes(1) = M−1, so start=M and end=M−1 and the start<=end guard drops the window. Thus the source excludes M even though the independent infectious fraction is positive.
conditional_example.kind: Representable public-API/source-level counterexample subject to the stated premises; actual stored deposit, supported timestamp reachability, desired maximum-time policy, disease outcome and runtime behavior were not observed.

analysis.stronger_gate_refinement: For (M−1,M], no deposit can yield any window: every calculated inclusive infectious end is at most M−1 after the final subtraction. Native exposure_windows.rs:18–26 therefore observes no qualifying window for any starter blood-compatible disease, regardless of whether other deposits exist. blood_attempts.rs:16–22 returns before wound routes, disease loop, replay, or checkpoint write. This strengthens the coordinator draft's no-other-deposit premise; it does not demonstrate actual product reachability or absence of all other disease paths.
analysis.wider_interval_qualification: For an interval ending at M that starts earlier, a separate deposit/minute may make the gate true before M; if execution then reaches the per-disease persistence branch with persist_checkpoint true and no intervening error, blood_attempts.rs:33–47, 96–98 and 120–137 can write evaluated_through=M even though these windows still never include M. This is conditional source control flow, not observed checkpoint mutation or demonstrated data loss. The one-minute query above instead exits before persistence.
analysis.native_trace_and_safeguards: The source-only native producer caps each deposit to remaining filth capacity and rejects a resulting zero amount, stores at:StrategicMinute, and snapshots supported unresolved source episodes (filth.rs:208–230, 236–283). The native reader reconstructs deposit data and requires provenance (310–348). filth.rs:140 includes blood_attempts.rs; exposure_windows.rs:9–26 delegates to the core window. disease.rs:1274–1283 calls replay for planning with persist=false; disease.rs:1823–1856, 1874–1885 selects the committed prefix and calls it with persist=true. These identify source paths and conditions, not a demonstrated database state, producer-to-clock reach, completed disease attempt, or actual commit.
